rationale: The description says the platform captures in-page interactions and micro-gestures, analyzes behavior into scores, visualizations and recommendations. These are concrete analytics outputs, but how the micro-gestures are interpreted and recommendations derived is unspecified; non-AI is best-supported but weak/forced.
evidence_spans: captures every in-page interaction and micro-gesture to understand the how and why of customer behavior.
We turn this analysis into scores, visualizations and recommendations
conflict_response: Micro-gesture interpretation and recommendations are material analytic functionality, not merely conventional reporting that can be presumed. The text describes the inputs and outputs but not the analytical method, and does not affirm AI; I therefore preserve a weak forced non-AI decision.
